apps.localizedDescription:
openQ4 for iPhone & Apple Vision Pro:

Play Quake 4 on your iPhone, iPad and Apple Vision Pro — the full story campaign, openQ4's offline Arena Campaign against bots, multiplayer between openQ4 players, and on Vision Pro a stereoscopic 3D mode that puts the game on a floating screen in your room with real depth.

Built on openQ4, the open-source replacement for the Quake 4 engine and game binaries, running its Vulkan renderer natively on Metal through MoltenVK.

You bring the game:

openQ4 ships with no Quake 4 game content — you must own Quake 4 and provide your own files. You need the retail q4base folder, patched to 1.4.2. The Steam and GOG releases are already patched; a disc install needs the official 1.4.2 patch first.

versions.localizedDescription:
openQ4 1.1.0 — Quake 4 for iPhone, iPad and Apple Vision Pro:

Built on openQ4 v0.14.000.

What's new:

• openQ4 v0.14.000 from upstream: more faithful sound and room reverb, smarter multiplayer bots, campaign and renderer fixes, and the classic Quake 4 menus by default again.
• Saves from 1.0.0 load right where you left off.

Add a SideStore source — openQ4 then updates itself. It is in both; add either one (Quake ports carries just the Quake family; All ports carries every port):

On Apple Vision Pro, first install SideStore onto the headset with.

Or install openq4-1.1.0-iOS.ipa / openq4-1.1.0-visionOS.ipa below with SideStore/AltStore yourself.

No game data is included. You need your own Quake 4, patched to 1.4.2 (Steam and GOG releases already are); the app asks for your q4base folder on first launch.
